neon.pack.name: Neon Archery
neon.pack.desc: Stringblade and its rechargeable Arc Quiver.
neon.gun.cyber_bow.desc: Charge the quiver first. Hold fire to draw, release to shoot. A longer draw flies faster and hits harder.
neon.ammo.cyber_arrow.desc: Shots available, derived from the quiver's energy.
neon.quiver.name: Arc Quiver
neon.quiver.desc: Energy quiver. Feed it FE, or right-click with redstone for one shot.
neon.quiver.energy.empty: Empty — right-click with redstone dust for one shot, or connect FE
